sentences.text: No internet. No cell signal. And still, your phone knows where it is — to within a few meters — using satellites twenty thousand two hundred kilometers overhead.
sentences.spoken: No internet. No cell signal. And still, your phone knows where it is — to within a few meters — using satellites twenty thousand two hundred kilometers overhead.

sentences.text: The trick is a clock. More than thirty GPS satellites are overhead right now, each circling the Earth twice a day, and every one carries an atomic clock, broadcasting exactly what time it is.
sentences.spoken: The trick is a clock. More than thirty GPS satellites are overhead right now, each circling the Earth twice a day, and every one carries an atomic clock, broadcasting exactly what time it is.

sentences.text: Your phone receives the signal a moment later, and measures the delay: about seven hundredths of a second — the twenty thousand kilometers, divided by the speed of light. {delay_marks}
sentences.spoken: Your phone receives the signal a moment later, and measures the delay: about seven hundredths of a second — the twenty thousand kilometers, divided by the speed of light.

sentences.text: The signal travels at the speed of light, and distance equals that speed times the delay. {eq_shown}About twenty one thousand kilometers.
sentences.spoken: The signal travels at the speed of light, and distance equals that speed times the delay. About twenty one thousand kilometers.

sentences.text: One satellite gives one distance: a sphere around it. {sphere_grows}
sentences.spoken: One satellite gives one distance: a sphere around it.

sentences.text: Three spheres intersect in one point. {spheres_close}That is where you are.
sentences.spoken: Three spheres intersect in one point. That is where you are.

sentences.text: Your phone's clock is not atomic, so a fourth satellite corrects it — solving position and time together. {fourth_draws}
sentences.spoken: Your phone's clock is not atomic, so a fourth satellite corrects it — solving position and time together.

sentences.text: Four satellites, one clock trick, and geometry: that is how GPS knows where you are.
sentences.spoken: Four satellites, one clock trick, and geometry: that is how GPS knows where you are.
